scope: Curated learning and discovery links, not verified REA builds

sources.title: REA Investigation Prompts (REAP)
sources.description: Copy-ready task-focused prompts and agent skills, including evidence-first feature tracing and clean-room reconstruction.

sources.title: Awesome-REA
sources.description: Broad REA and reverse-engineering discovery portal with cases, tools, papers and an API. Its large index is not the same as verified builds.

sources.title: Awesome Reverse Engineering
sources.description: General-purpose reverse-engineering tools and learning materials from the REA creator. Most entries are not REA projects.

sources.title: Awesome Reverse Engineer Anything
sources.description: REA vs other AI-reversing attribution checks, compatible projects, and a weekly digest. Assess claims against their primary sources.

resources.title: Start safely with REA
resources.description: Installation/verification prompt; review the setup plan before changing an agent's configuration.

resources.title: Trace one feature with evidence
resources.description: Find entry points, data flow and observable effects while separating facts from hypotheses.

resources.title: Investigate native binaries
resources.description: Prompts for executable triage and function-level research; start with static analysis.

resources.title: Specify clean-room reconstructions
resources.description: Write behavior specifications without redistributing proprietary code or assets.

resources.title: Plan a game-to-WASM port
resources.description: Prompts to separate a game's platform dependencies, simulation and browser porting tasks.

resources.title: Inspect Electron and JavaScript behavior
resources.description: Workflow ideas for inspecting app bundles, preload bridges and UI feature behavior.

resources.title: Evidence-first prompt-writing tips
resources.description: How to narrow a hypothesis, request reproducible evidence and keep unknowns visible.

resources.title: Awesome-REA case explorer
resources.description: Broad searchable catalog of reverse-engineering cases; apply this atlas's inclusion rules before adding candidates.

resources.title: Awesome-REA resource index
resources.description: Cross-domain tools, protocols, websites, games, binary and firmware resources.

resources.title: Awesome-REA papers
resources.description: Research-paper discovery index; papers are supporting references, not build passports.

resources.title: Did it really use REA?
resources.description: Case-by-case attribution checks distinguishing direct REA use from other AI-assisted reversing.

resources.title: Reimplementations organized by target app
resources.description: Find alternatives by the application they replace; verify tool attribution separately.

resources.title: New REA and AI-reversing cases
resources.description: A dated discovery feed; new entries are candidates, not automatic additions.

resources.title: What is REA?
resources.description: Background FAQ, terminology and distinctions between REA and other agent-assisted approaches.

resources.title: Ghidra
resources.description: Decompilation, disassembly and headless native binary analysis. A standalone tool, not itself an REA implementation.

resources.title: Cutter
resources.description: Open-source graphical reverse-engineering environment based on Rizin.

resources.title: JADX
resources.description: Decompile and inspect Android APK and DEX files; behavior recovery still needs validation.

resources.title: Frida
resources.description: Dynamic instrumentation and call tracing for authorized targets.

resources.title: Detect It Easy
resources.description: Executable format, compiler and packer identification before deeper analysis.

resources.title: radare2
resources.description: Command-line binary analysis and debugging toolkit with scripting support.

resources.title: OpenSecurityTraining2
resources.description: Training in assembly, architecture, debugging and fundamental reverse engineering.

resources.title: pwn.college
resources.description: Browser-accessible security and reversing challenges, with appropriate authorized lab targets.

resources.title: Reverse Engineering for Beginners
resources.description: Free book connecting C/C++ source, compiler output and assembly across architectures.
